def transform(grid):
    # The output marks every cell not occupied by the input shape;
    # complementary color depends on the input's nonzero color.
    c = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v)
    fill = 2 if c == 8 else 1
    return [[0 if v else fill for v in row] for row in grid]
